test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the word that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word.**

Adversity
solution: The correct answer is** fortune**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Adversity: **difficulties or problems. (कठिनाइयाँ, समस्‍याएँ, मुसीबतें; विपत्तियाँ) • **Fortune: **luck, especially good luck. (भाग्य, विशेष रूप से सौभाग्य) • Thus, the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Affliction: **a cause of persistent pain or distress. (दुख, वेदना, मनस्‍ताप) • **Brilliance: **great intelligence or skill. (चमक-दमक, दीप्ति, बुद्धिमता) • **Penury: **the state of being very poor. (अत्यधिक ग़रीबी) 3b:T5d7, The correct answer is **Let us bid farewell to our seniors**.
